sentences: An active destination reads the selected source lane's VGPR.
If EXEC disables that source, the read returns zero; a disabled destination keeps its prior value.
The [hardware measurements](shader_validation.md#hardware-oracle-for-the-lds-programs---oracle-hw) confirm the disabled-source result on gfx1036 and gfx1150.
In the seven-invocation CPU fixture, lane 6 selects lane 7, which is absent.
The translator returns zero in that case; the corresponding result on hardware is unverified.
